declined.subject: page-load-pipeline
declined.reason: Precondition of page-load-pipeline does not hold for desktop-setup-module: this context consists of TypeScript view-models, readiness derivation functions, React hooks, and unit tests for first-run daemon engine selection (ADR 0085); its views, glyphs, and stylesheets were removed during the scene cutover (ADR 0095), and the module does not own document navigation, HTML head resources, fonts, layout placeholders, or network waterfalls. As not-applicable is barred from this seat, the pair is declined.
